config_plain.label: Values read
config_plain.value: 4 core values (name, symbol, decimals, totalSupply) + optional balanceOf(holder), pinned to the live block at read time

one_liner: Reads 4 typed values from a live mainnet contract via the Chain MCP — plus an optional holder balance — all pinned to one block, with an independently verified storage-slot proof.
what_it_does: This lamp reads real values straight out of a live contract on Pharos mainnet (the Chain MCP serves mainnet only) — no copying, no guessing. The four core reads (name, symbol, decimals, totalSupply) are Chain MCP eth_call tools/calls by name, every one pinned to the single live block the run reads at, so nothing shifts mid-report. Add a holder address and a fifth read joins (balanceOf) — with no holder set, that step is skipped by design, not failed. The contract's storage was also read directly (get_storage_at, raw slot 0) as an independent cross-check. Nothing here is Atlantic-era: the current build is mainnet-only, proven by live MCP reads, a per-run manifest, and the Tier-A storage evidence linked below.
